item.title: Anchor Capital: Precious metals rally lifts JSE All Share 4.3% in August
item.description: Anchor Capital flagged strong August gains in global equities, masking a late-month volatility spike tied to geopolitics, oil, Fed hawkishness. Bond markets
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Anchor Capital flagged strong August gains in global equities, masking a late-month volatility spike tied to geopolitics, oil, Fed hawkishness. Bond markets sold off on US debt fears above USD 40 trillion; a Treasury intervention briefly lowered yields before pressures returned. MSCI World rose 2.6% in August; S&P 500 gained 2.5%; Nasdaq added 3.6% despite tech rotation. JSE All Share climbed 4.3% in August; resources jumped 25.4% as gold and PGM prices surged. Gold rose 9.7% to an intramonth high of USD 4,690/oz; Brent moved above USD 90/bbl late-month on Middle East risks. item.title: Sector Update: Consumer Stocks Mixed Late Afternoon
item.description: 03:41 PM EDT, 09/01/2026 (MT Newswires) -- Consumer stocks were mixed late Tuesday afternoon, with the State Street Consumer Staples Select Sector SPDR ETF
item.dc:creator: MT newswire
item.content:encoded: 03:41 PM EDT, 09/01/2026 (MT Newswires) -- Consumer stocks were mixed late Tuesday afternoon, with the State Street Consumer Staples Select Sector SPDR ETF (XLP) increasing 0.3% and the State Street Consumer Discretionary Select Sector SPDR ETF (XLY) falling 1.8%. Redbook US same-store sales rose by 9.6% from a year earlier in the week ended Aug. 29 after a 9.1% year-over-year increase in the previous week. Redbook noted that most companies reported strong back-to-school demand for children's and juniors' apparel and footwear. In corporate news, August registrations for new Tesla (TSLA) vehicles, a proxy for sales, rose by 279% in France and 104% in Denmark from a year ago, Reuters reported Tuesday, citing data from French car industry body PFA and Danish vehicle data platform bilstatistik.dk. Meanwhile, registrations in Norway and Spain fell by 79%, and they fell in Sweden, Portugal and Italy by 41%, 37% and 36%, respectively, the report said, citing data from industry groups and Italy's Transport Ministry. Tesla shares were down 3.3%. Boxabl (BXBL) shares rose 4% after the company said LC Vegas Acquisitions agreed to buy up to 1,500 of its factory-built homes over a three-year period. Ford (F) is recalling 148,663 US vehicles over potential loss of drive power and failures affecting headlights or the windshield washer system, Reuters reported, citing the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration. Ford shares fell 1.5%. Stellantis (STLA) will suspend production at its Mirafiori factory in Turin, Italy, between Sept. 2 and Sept. 4, several media outlets reported Tuesday, citing statements from the company and the FIOM trade union. Its shares declined 2.6%.

item.title: Sector Update: Tech Stocks Fall Late Afternoon
item.description: 03:38 PM EDT, 09/01/2026 (MT Newswires) -- Tech stocks were lower late Tuesday afternoon, with the State Street Technology Select Sector SPDR ETF (XLK) fall
item.dc:creator: MT newswire
item.content:encoded: 03:38 PM EDT, 09/01/2026 (MT Newswires) -- Tech stocks were lower late Tuesday afternoon, with the State Street Technology Select Sector SPDR ETF (XLK) falling 1.5% and the State Street SPDR S&P Semiconductor ETF (XSD) dropping 2.2%. The Philadelphia Semiconductor index shed 2.2%. In corporate news, GoPro (GPRO) shares surged 42% after the company and optical-photonics company Starman Optical said Tuesday they have signed a definitive merger agreement. Under the terms of the deal, GoPro shareholders will receive $1.14 per share, for a total of $285 million in cash and will retain a stake in the combined company of about 10%. Amazon-backed (AMZN) Anthropic has agreed to a $35 billion computing deal with Nvidia-backed (NVDA) cloud provider Lambda, Bloomberg reported. The project involves a Texas data center being developed by Hut 8 (HUT), with Nvidia holding the lease, the report said. Amazon shares were down 2.2%, and Nvidia was shedding 1.7%. Apple (AAPL) is continuing to reshape its leadership ranks as John Ternus begins his tenure as chief executive officer, with longtime executive Luca Maestri stepping away from his corporate services responsibilities, Bloomberg reported. Maestri's duties, including information technology, information security and corporate real estate, have been assumed by Chief Financial Officer Kevan Parekh, according to Apple's updated management biographies, the report said. Apple shares were up 2.7%. Duolingo (DUOL) shares jumped 7% after Evercore ISI upgraded the stock to outperform from in-line and raised its price target to $210 from $105.

item.title: Generation Mining highlights C$ 1.07 billion NPV for Marathon copper-palladium project in investor deck
item.description: Generation Mining circulated a corporate presentation outlining updated economics for its Marathon copper-palladium project in Ontario. Feasibility metrics
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Generation Mining circulated a corporate presentation outlining updated economics for its Marathon copper-palladium project in Ontario. Feasibility metrics showed after-tax IRR of 28% using study prices, rising to 38% at spot prices. After-tax NPV at a 6% discount rate was CAD 1.07 billion on study prices, increasing to CAD 1.6 billion at spot prices. Initial capital was CAD 662 million, with a payback period of 1.6 years on study prices. Funding plan highlighted a CAD 240 million Wheaton Precious Metals stream, up to USD 310 million senior debt, CAD 200 million subordinated debt.
